target.title: fix(zalouser): clear probe timeout after auth resolves
target.body:
## Summary
- Clear the zalouser probe timeout handle once the auth lookup resolves or rejects.
- Keep the existing timeout fallback behavior for slow auth lookups.
- Collision check: open PR file search returned no PR modifying `extensions/zalouser/src/probe.ts` before opening.

## Verification
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-zalo.config.ts extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts -t "clears the probe timeout after auth resolves" --reporter verbose` - passed, 1 focused spec.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts` - passed, 1 file / 6 specs.
- `git diff --check` - passed.

## Real behavior proof
Behavior or issue addressed: Zalouser probe calls with a timeout now clear the scheduled fallback timer after the auth lookup completes, so a stale timer is not left behind on the resolved-auth path.

Real environment tested: Local OpenClaw checkout on Linux at commit db7e5b74df, Node.js v22.22.0, using the modified `extensions/zalouser/src/probe.ts` from this branch.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-zalo.config.ts extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts -t "clears the probe timeout after auth resolves" --reporter verbose
```

Evidence after fix: Terminal output from the current branch focused behavior test:
```text
The `envFile` option is deprecated, please use `envDir: false` instead.

 RUN  v4.1.9 /media/vdc/0668001470/workSpace/claw-campaign/wt-zalouser-probe-timeout-cleanup

 ↓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > returns ok=true with user when authenticated
 ↓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > returns not authenticated when no user info is returned
 ↓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > returns error when user lookup throws
 ↓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > times out when lookup takes too long
 ✓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > clears the probe timeout after auth resolves 184ms
 ↓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalouser/src/probe.test.ts > probeZalouser > caps oversized lookup timeout before scheduling

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 5 skipped (6)
   Start at  21:38:39
   Duration  1.37s (transform 854ms, setup 801ms, import 63ms, tests 190ms, environment 0ms)
```

Observed result after fix: The focused spec invokes `probeZalouser("default", 10)` with `getZaloUserInfo` mocked to resolve as an authenticated user, then asserts `clearTimeout` is called exactly once and `vi.getTimerCount()` is `0`. That exercises the resolved-auth timeout path rather than only checking source text.

What was not tested: No external Zalo account login was exercised; this is a local unit-level proof of the probe timeout cleanup path.
